description: Watch one Derive, Paradex or Rysk option to expiry, sold or bought: a heads-up the day before, the outcome once it settles, and, only if asked, buying the asset an assigned put agreed to.

VENUE.description: The venue the option trades on: derive (the default), paradex or rysk. Every options read the duty makes names it. On rysk only a sold put (cash_secured_put) is watched.

INSTRUMENT.description: The venue's own name for the option, exactly as it was filled: ETH-20261030-2450-P on Derive, ETH-USD-30OCT26-2450-P on Paradex, ETH-30OCT26-2450-P on Rysk. The expiry and strike are read back out of this, so it must match the fill.

PRODUCT.description: cash_secured_put or covered_call for a note the owner SOLD (income); long_call or long_put for an option they BOUGHT. Must match the P/C in INSTRUMENT.

UNDERLYING.description: The asset ticker, the prefix of INSTRUMENT: ETH, BTC, SOL, HYPE or any other currency the venue lists options on. Used for the settlement read on Derive.

TOKEN_ID.description: Only with DELIVER_ASSET: the token the delivery buy trades, pinned from the /token-search row for UNDERLYING when the duty is filed. native:<chainId> for a chain's coin (ETH on Base is native:8453), <address>:<chainId> for a token such as cbBTC. The heads-up does not need it: it reads Derive's own index for the option.

STRIKE.description: The price the owner agreed to buy at (put) or sell at (call).

SIZE.description: Contracts sold, in units of the underlying.

PREMIUM_USD.description: For a sold note, what the owner kept at open, net of the venue's fee. For a bought option, the total it cost including the fee (the open's totalCostUsd). Quoted back at expiry.

COLLATERAL_USD.description: USDC locked behind a sold put, as the open reported it. 0 for a covered call and for any bought option.

DELIVER_ASSET.description: Only for a sold put that settles in the money (cash_secured_put). Derive and Paradex settle in cash, so the owner holds the loss in cash and no asset. With this on, the duty spends SIZE x the settlement price of wallet USDC buying the TOKEN_ID token on its chain, so TOKEN_ID is required with it. Off by default: it spends money, so the owner has to have asked. Not on Rysk, which delivers the asset itself.

HEADS_UP_HOURS.description: How long before expiry to send the heads-up. Sent once.
